title: Automation Flow Rules
name: Name
conditionStatusPlaceholder: Empty means no condition (event fires as-is)
deleteConfirm: Delete this rule? It will no longer fire.
actionRequired: Configure at least one complete action
triggerCronPlaceholder: cron expression (5 fields: min hour day month weekday, e.g. */5 * * * *)
delaySecondsPlaceholder: Delay seconds (1-604800, following actions run after it)
elseActionRequired: Else branch is enabled: configure at least one complete action
notifyContentEnPlaceholder: English body variant (optional) — recipients preferring English get this in email
httpHeadersPlaceholder: Custom headers (one per line, Key: Value, max 8)
httpBodyPlaceholder: Body template (POST only; {status}/{title}/{slug} snapshot placeholders supported; default envelope when empty)
conditionsHint: Snapshot field AND matching: status/prev_status/title/slug/author_id/category_id/cf.<custom field key>; comment events add content/object_id/authorType, media events add mime_type/file_name, user events add username/email
